slides.headline: 6 BIOTECH STOCK PROMPTS SO GOOD THEY FEEL ILLEGAL
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei at late-night diner counter, quiet satisfaction, eyes to camera, hand holding printed report, laptop glowing with rising chart. Warm amber tungsten light, navy booth. Documentary 35mm, harsh flash, natural skin, film grain.

slides.headline: 1) READ ANY DRUG TRIAL LIKE A WALL STREET ANALYST
slides.body: Moderna's Phase 3 release was dense clinical data. Most investors couldn't parse it. "Here are [company]'s trial results. Tell me what they mean for the stock price in plain English."

slides.headline: 2) FIND EVERY RED FLAG BEFORE YOU BUY
slides.body: Most earnings surprises hide in footnotes. You miss them every time. "Here is [company]'s annual report. List every red flag that could cause the stock to fall. Rank by severity."

slides.headline: 3) MAP THE WHOLE SECTOR IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: After any stock moves 100%, its whole sector shifts. "[Company]'s stock just moved 110%. Name the 5 companies in the same sector most affected and whether each wins or loses."

slides.headline: 4) BUILD A FULL ANALYST REPORT IN 5 MINUTES
slides.body: A Bloomberg Terminal costs $24,000 a year. These 5 minutes are free. "Write a one-page analyst report on [company]. Cover what they do, key risks, biggest upside, and a bear case."

slides.headline: 5) FIND THE COMPETITOR THAT BENEFITS NEXT
slides.body: When a biotech wins Phase 3, related companies often spike within days. "Moderna just won a cancer vaccine trial. Name 3 other biotech companies that might benefit from this and why."

slides.headline: 6) STRESS-TEST YOUR THESIS BEFORE YOU BUY
slides.body: Most investors only look for reasons to buy. That is why they lose. "I believe [company] is a strong buy because [your reason]. Give me the 3 strongest arguments against this thesis."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 6 STOCK RESEARCH PROMPTS
slides.body:
